name: Amp
summary: Coding agent that runs tasks in isolated hosted or self-hosted environments called orbs.
description: Amp is a coding agent and development environment. Each agent runs in its own isolated environment, called an orb, so tasks continue after the user closes their laptop and can be followed from a phone. Threads can be shared with teammates. The Hobby plan is free with pay-as-you-go usage and unlimited self-hosted orbs; the Individual plan costs $20 per month, with higher team tiers above it.
